mentions.name: Screensnipe
mentions.description: A screenshot and screen recording tool built as a personal replacement for Snagit, focused on speed and including exactly the features the author needs with no extra bloat.
mentions.problem: The author's Snagit license was up for renewal, but the app had become bloated and kept getting in the way, so they wanted a fast, minimal alternative tailored to their own needs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I'm building my own replacement.

Yes, it's another screenshot and recording tool. But this one has exactly the features I need, nothing more and nothing less. It's like a home-cooked meal.
mentions.author: vucetica
